This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 28-02-2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Randstad
Componenten BV, with its registered office at Industrieweg 88, Amsterdam ("Party A"), and Van Dijk Handel BV, with its registered office
at Industrieweg 88, Amsterdam ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
